title: Introduction to Fractions
description: Learn what fractions are using pizza, cake, and fun interactive activities. Perfect for students just starting their fractions journey.
subject: Math
learningObjectives: Understand that fractions represent parts of a whole
Recognize that fraction parts must be equal in size
Identify the numerator (top number) and denominator (bottom number)
Read and write simple fractions like 1/4, 2/6, 3/5
Compare fractions by counting pieces (e.g., 1/6 has more pieces than 1/4)
